correctness.rationale: Direct derivation block identities yield a=0, T in sp(V), T²=0, fT=0. Symplectic orthogonality identifies each such T with an isotropic image W and a symmetric isomorphism W* to W; the rank and kernel pairing identities follow by considering whether f vanishes on kerT. Symplectic Grassmannians and symmetric-form bundles give the two smooth strata with consecutive dimensions. The counting uses exact isotropic-frame and nonsingular-symmetric-form counts, with no characteristic restriction. Standalone checker exhaustively reconstructs original equations for n=1 over F2,F3,F4 and n=2 over F2; finite tests do not replace the all-field argument.
